name: Venomancer: Fungal Allies adds Fungarians to Fungal Assailant (#1378)
contract: #1378: Fungal Allies (681054) reads 'Fungal Assailant now summons $s1 additional Fungarians'. Its effect 0 is a SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 (aura 107, op 3) of +2 on Fungal Assailant (504344), whose summon is skipped by spell_ascension_venomancer_ability and re-done in AscensionVenomancer::Summon with a hard-coded count of 1, so the modifier never reached the summon. Without the passive one Fungarian (45896) is summoned; with it 1 + 2 = 3. Both casts share one run so the count is compared against its own baseline.
